title: Dozens killed in India’s northeast after rains trigger floods, landslides
description: Relentless monsoon rains across the northeastern states leave a trail of deaths and destruction.
content:
At least 30 people have died in Indias northeast after relentless monsoon rains caused floods and landslides over the weekend, Indian officials and media reports say.
